seasonal_note: Fall (Sep-Nov) demand spike raises prices and wait times; spring/summer cheapest. '$99 special' is bait, not a range floor.
Often bundled with a sweep. High end = multi-flue. 'Starting at' banners are floors, not medians.

seasonal_note: 3 companies explicitly price case-by-case ('our rep will give exact pricing'). $500-$5,000 is a typical project-total band, not a flat rate. Invasive/demolition.
P2: 5 real company pages checked - only 2 (OH, CT) publish single-market numbers; 3 more omit price and push to quote. Stage-3/PCR is industry-wide inspect-then-quote. $300-$1,500 indicative band.
Installed (part + labor). Company all-in quotes cluster $175-$549.

P2-hardened: bimodal, now company-confirmed. Basic box/rectangular 2-flue cover $300-$700 (Archer); true custom-fabricated stainless multi-flue $1,400-$2,500+ (Brown Chimney). Two different SKUs under one name.

P2: upgraded low->medium. Chimney Caps Atlanta posts an explicit full-coverage SKU ('Flat Roof starting $849 / Hip Roof starting $1,050') distinct from single-flue. Naming still fragmented (full-coverage/multi-flue/chase); most shops custom-quote. Large crowns run higher.

Factory-built/framed chases (distinct from masonry crowns). Guides cluster $300-$700 standard; stainless/copper & large custom to $2,500+ (copper ~$3,800). Spring/fall peak. NOTE: Gerrior page self-discloses figures are 'internet data, not actual Gerrior costs' (guide-style).
Installed total (excludes material-only $150-$300). Cheaper of the two damper types.

P2-hardened: top-of-flue cap/damper (Lock-Top/Lyemance class). Archer posts $250-$600 installed; ChimneySweeps $500-$900 installed total. No source names the brand w/ a price, but category matches across 2 companies. Excludes parts-only ($250-$500).
Wide by scope: minor patch $150-$700, resurfacing $800-$1,200, crack repair $350-$2,300. Company prices by footprint formula.
Full removal + recast. Guides converge $1,000-$3,000; company formula flags large/multi-flue crowns to supervisor quote. Winter curing affects scheduling.

UNIT = per sq ft (chimney-specific, > wall tuckpointing). Whole-chimney job typically $500-$2,500 (avg ~$1,200); 2-story/complex $5,000-$7,000. Do NOT average per-sqft against job totals. '$20-$50 per row' is an incompatible alt unit.

PROJECT TOTAL for re-bricking the stack above the roofline. Alt unit $100-$300/linear ft. Partial (top few ft) $600-$1,000; tall/2-story >$5,000. No company publishes a fixed number - on-site quoted (3 independent guides support the band).

P2: Pratt's confirms inspect-then-quote (no price); others publish only 'repair' ranges topping $1,000-$2,500, not full masonry rebuild. Full brick/stone rebuilds can exceed $2,500 - no company commits to a rebuild ceiling in writing.
INSTALLED JOB TOTAL (normalization). Alt: materials $20-$90/linear ft; installed ~$100-$200/ft; one company $250-$350/ft (outlier, excluded). 1-story ~$2,500, 2-story ~$5,000.

P2: every company either offers free on-site estimates (no price) or gives only a HeatShield ceramic-resurfacing figure ($3,000-$4,000+, a DIFFERENT product from a true GoldenFlue/SupaFlu pour). On Duty posts $3,000-$8,500 whole-liner-category. Band widened to $2,000-$8,500.
Full step/counter flashing replacement $400-$1,600; simple resealing $150-$300 (context, not median). Contractors busiest late summer/fall.
Professional application of vapor-permeable sealant (ChimneySaver type). All 3 converge $150-$650. DIY sealant ~$35-$90/gal (~100 sq ft).
Roof vents run higher ($150-$250). Excludes add-ons (bird-nest, vent replacement). Angi/HomeAdvisor same parent - counted once.

P2: floor raised $300->$400 on new tiered wildlife-control pricing (Good $400-$800 / Better $800-$1,200 / Best $1,200+). Chimney-specific removal bundles trapping + exclusion cap + sealing. Watch '$99 special' inspection-fee teasers. Chimney swifts federally protected.

P2-hardened medium->high: 3 geographically diverse companies (MI/WA/CO) converge $150-$250 (Fire Starters $175, Seattle $129-249, Denver $195). Fire Starters posts $150 off-season (May-Aug) vs $175 in-season - a real seasonal delta (see SEASONAL-PREMIUMS).

P2-hardened medium->high: WA (Soot Slayer $179-$219) + VA (Edwards $230-$245) companies converge with guides. Edwards posts a spring/summer promo ($245->$230) - fall-rush signal (see SEASONAL-PREMIUMS).

P2: stale Canadian source replaced by Burlington Fireplace (WI) US company. Installed project total incl. stove+venting+hearth. Guides $1,500-$4,500 (most ~$3,000); Burlington posts $4,000-$7,000 all-in for larger jobs (widens top). Labor-only far less ($250-$800). Fall/winter peak.

P2: stays low - prices split sharply between labor-only (~$500-$5,000) and fully-installed unit+labor packages (Brown Chimney posts wood insert $11,995 / gas $12,995 all-in). Fuel-type dependent. RECOMMEND schema split (labor-only vs unit-included) so numbers aren't conflated.
